words.note: medical care 是 healthcare 最直接、最常見的近義說法之一，尤其當重點是醫生、護士、醫院或診所提供的診斷、治療和照護。
words.example: Everyone should have access to affordable medical care.
words.exampleZh: 每個人都應該能獲得負擔得起的醫療照護。

exercises.original: The charity helps low-income families gain access to basic healthcare.
exercises.zh: 這個慈善機構幫助低收入家庭獲得基本醫療照護。
exercises.upgrade: medical care · 醫療照護；醫療服務

options.explanation: social care = 社會照護。較著重日常生活支援，不等於一般醫療照護。
medical care = 醫療照護。basic care + access for families 是最直接的替換。
insurance = 保險。是支付機制，不是照護本身。
public health = 公共衛生。重點在群體預防與政策，而非個別病人的照護。
welfare = 福利。範圍太廣。
therapy only = 只有治療。醫療照護還包括診斷、監察、預防等。

exercises.original: Rural residents often travel long distances to receive healthcare from doctors and nurses.
exercises.zh: 偏遠地區居民常要長途跋涉，才能接受醫生和護士提供的醫療照護。
exercises.upgrade: medical care · 醫療照護；醫療服務

options.explanation: welfare = 福利。不能精準表示 doctors and nurses 提供的服務。
insurance = 保險。不是實際接受的照護。
public health = 公共衛生。不是個人去找醫生護士接受治療。
social support = 社會支援。範圍不同。
medical care = 醫療照護。receive care from doctors and nurses 是標準搭配。
home help = 家居協助。過窄且不一定是醫療。

exercises.original: The new clinic will provide healthcare for people who cannot afford private treatment.
exercises.zh: 新診所將為無力負擔私家治療的人提供醫療照護。
exercises.upgrade: medical care · 醫療照護；醫療服務

options.explanation: medical care = 醫療照護。clinic + private treatment 是明確醫療服務語境。
insurance = 保險。診所提供的是照護，不是保單。
welfare = 福利。太廣。
public health = 公共衛生。不是個別診所向患者提供的臨床照護。
social care = 社會照護。通常處理日常生活支援。
counselling = 輔導。只是其中一種服務，範圍太窄。

words.meaning: 健康服務；醫療衛生服務
words.note: 當 healthcare 指由醫院、診所、政府或社區提供的一整套健康相關服務時，可用 health services。它比 medical care 更容易涵蓋預防、篩查、康復和社區服務。
words.example: The region needs better access to mental-health and preventive health services.
words.exampleZh: 這個地區需要更容易取得精神健康和預防性健康服務。

exercises.original: The government plans to expand healthcare in rural areas by opening more clinics and screening centres.
exercises.zh: 政府計劃透過增設診所和篩查中心，擴展偏遠地區的健康服務。
exercises.upgrade: health services · 健康服務；醫療衛生服務

options.explanation: insurance = 保險。不是 clinics and screening centres 本身。
welfare = 福利。範圍太廣。
social care = 社會照護。未必包括篩查和診所。
health services = 健康服務。clinics + screening centres 表示多種類型服務。
private practice = 私人執業。和政府擴展服務不符。
medicine = 醫學／藥物。不是整套服務。

exercises.original: The report found major gaps in healthcare for older people, especially rehabilitation and home visits.
exercises.zh: 報告發現長者健康服務有很大缺口，尤其是復康和家訪。
exercises.upgrade: health services · 健康服務；醫療衛生服務

options.explanation: health policy = 健康政策。是規劃和規則，不是實際提供的服務。
medical insurance = 醫療保險。是支付安排。
health services = 健康服務。rehabilitation + home visits 都是典型服務項目。
social welfare = 社會福利。可能相關，但不等於醫療與復康服務。
pharmacy = 藥房／藥劑服務。只是一部分。
surgery = 手術。範圍太窄。

exercises.original: Students were asked to map the healthcare available in their local community.
exercises.zh: 學生被要求整理本地社區可獲得的健康服務。
exercises.upgrade: health services · 健康服務；醫療衛生服務

options.explanation: insurance = 保險。只是支付方式。
public policy = 公共政策。不是可使用的服務。
welfare = 福利。太廣。
medicine = 醫學／藥物。不能直接表示可取得的服務網絡。
private treatment = 私家治療。只是一個部分。
health services = 健康服務。available in the community 是非常自然的搭配。

words.note: medical services 強調由醫療專業人員或醫療機構提供的具體服務，例如診症、檢查、急救或治療。它比 health services 更偏臨床和醫療。
words.example: The hospital provides emergency and specialist medical services.
words.exampleZh: 醫院提供急症和專科醫療服務。

exercises.original: The hospital expanded its healthcare to include a new cardiology unit and 24-hour emergency care.
exercises.zh: 醫院擴展醫療服務，加入新的心臟科和二十四小時急症照護。
exercises.upgrade: medical services · 醫療服務

options.explanation: welfare = 福利。太廣。
insurance = 保險。不是醫院提供的臨床內容。
social care = 社會照護。不是心臟科或急症服務。
public health = 公共衛生。偏群體與預防。
medical services = 醫療服務。cardiology + emergency care 都是具體臨床服務。
housing support = 住房支援。無關。

exercises.original: The refugee centre arranged healthcare such as vaccinations, check-ups, and treatment for minor injuries.
exercises.zh: 難民中心安排了疫苗、身體檢查和輕傷治療等醫療服務。
exercises.upgrade: medical services · 醫療服務

options.explanation: welfare = 福利。太廣。
medical services = 醫療服務。vaccinations, check-ups, treatment 都是具體服務。
insurance = 保險。不是實際照護。
public health campaigns = 公共衛生活動。疫苗可屬其中，但 check-ups and treatment 顯示更廣臨床服務。
housing support = 住房支援。無關。
social work = 社會工作。不是醫療診治。

exercises.original: The company contracts with a local provider to offer healthcare to workers at the site.
exercises.zh: 公司與本地供應者簽約，在工地為員工提供醫療服務。
exercises.upgrade: medical services · 醫療服務

options.explanation: medical services = 醫療服務。local provider + workers at the site 是自然搭配。
welfare = 福利。太廣。
social care = 社會照護。不是一般工地醫療。
public policy = 公共政策。不是公司現場服務。
housing support = 住房支援。無關。
insurance only = 只有保險。provider at the site 表示實際服務。

words.note: 當 healthcare 特別指病人直接接受醫療專業人員的診斷、監察和治療，可用 clinical care。它比 healthcare 更窄，不包括保險、政策或純行政服務。
words.example: The programme aims to improve clinical care for stroke patients.
words.exampleZh: 這個計劃旨在改善中風病人的臨床照護。

exercises.original: The review focused on the quality of healthcare received by patients during their hospital stay.
exercises.zh: 這次檢討聚焦病人在住院期間接受的臨床照護質素。
exercises.upgrade: clinical care · 臨床照護；臨床醫療

options.explanation: insurance = 保險。不是病人在病房實際接受的照護。
public health = 公共衛生。不是個別住院病人的臨床過程。
clinical care = 臨床照護。patients during hospital stay 是最直接線索。
social care = 社會照護。範圍不同。
health policy = 健康政策。不是實際病人照護。
welfare = 福利。太廣。

exercises.original: The hospital introduced new guidelines to make healthcare for diabetes patients more consistent.
exercises.zh: 醫院推出新指引，使糖尿病患者的臨床照護更一致。
exercises.upgrade: clinical care · 臨床照護；臨床醫療

options.explanation: social support = 社會支援。不是醫院臨床治療流程。
insurance = 保險。無關照護一致性。
welfare = 福利。太廣。
public health policy = 公共衛生政策。較偏群體層面。
housing assistance = 住房協助。無關。
clinical care = 臨床照護。hospital guidelines + diabetes patients 是典型。

exercises.original: The study compared healthcare outcomes across five specialist cancer centres.
exercises.zh: 研究比較五間癌症專科中心的臨床照護結果。
exercises.upgrade: clinical care · 臨床照護；臨床醫療

options.explanation: insurance outcomes = 保險結果。不是癌症中心的治療結果。
welfare = 福利。無關。
public policy = 公共政策。不是中心內病人結果。
clinical care = 臨床照護。specialist cancer centres + outcomes 是典型。
health promotion = 健康促進。偏預防與教育。
social care = 社會照護。不是癌症專科臨床結果。

words.note: 當 healthcare 從病人的角度強調照顧、溝通、安全、舒適、治療與整體經驗時，可用 patient care。它很常見於醫院質素和醫護工作語境。
words.example: Good communication is essential to high-quality patient care.
words.exampleZh: 良好溝通對高質素病人照護非常重要。

exercises.original: The hospital wants nurses to spend more time on direct healthcare rather than paperwork.
exercises.zh: 醫院希望護士把更多時間用於直接病人照護，而不是文書工作。
exercises.upgrade: patient care · 病人照護；患者照護

options.explanation: administration = 行政。後半句正是要減少 paperwork。
patient care = 病人照護。direct + nurses + rather than paperwork 是標準搭配。
public health = 公共衛生。不是床邊直接照護。
social welfare = 社會福利。不是臨床病人照護。
insurance = 保險。護士主要不是處理保單。
policy = 政策。不是直接服務。

exercises.original: The award recognises teams that improve healthcare by making patients safer and more comfortable.
exercises.zh: 這個獎項表揚透過提升安全和舒適度來改善病人照護的團隊。
exercises.upgrade: patient care · 病人照護；患者照護

options.explanation: patient care = 病人照護。patients safer and more comfortable 是最直接線索。
insurance = 保險。不是病人安全與舒適。
public health = 公共衛生。較偏群體。
medical billing = 醫療收費。不是照護質素。
welfare = 福利。太廣。
research = 研究。可能改善照護，但不是此句直接對象。

exercises.original: Better staffing levels can improve healthcare by allowing doctors and nurses more time with each patient.
exercises.zh: 增加人手可讓醫生和護士有更多時間照顧每位病人，從而改善病人照護。
exercises.upgrade: patient care · 病人照護；患者照護

options.explanation: insurance = 保險。和 staff time 無關。
health policy = 健康政策。這裡是實際照護效果。
public health = 公共衛生。不是個別病人互動。
welfare = 福利。太廣。
patient care = 病人照護。more time with each patient 是直接線索。
social care = 社會照護。範圍不同。

words.note: 當 healthcare 的重點是對疾病或受傷進行具體治療，而不是整套健康制度或預防服務時，可用 medical treatment。它比 healthcare 範圍窄。
words.example: He needed immediate medical treatment after the accident.
words.exampleZh: 意外後，他需要立即接受醫療治療。

exercises.original: The injured workers were taken to hospital for urgent healthcare.
exercises.zh: 受傷工人被送往醫院接受緊急醫療治療。
exercises.upgrade: medical treatment · 醫療治療；醫治

options.explanation: insurance = 保險。不能處理受傷本身。
welfare = 福利。不是緊急治療。
social care = 社會照護。不是事故後急診。
health promotion = 健康促進。偏預防。
public health = 公共衛生。不是個別傷者治療。
medical treatment = 醫療治療。injured + hospital + urgent 是典型。

exercises.original: Without healthcare, the infection could have become much more serious.
exercises.zh: 如果沒有接受醫療治療，感染可能會變得嚴重得多。
exercises.upgrade: medical treatment · 醫療治療；醫治

options.explanation: insurance = 保險。保險本身不能治療感染。
social welfare = 社會福利。不是臨床治療。
medical treatment = 醫療治療。infection becoming serious 是明確治療語境。
health education = 健康教育。不能替代感染治療。
public health = 公共衛生。偏群體防控。
home support = 家居支援。過窄且非醫療。

exercises.original: The condition usually improves quickly with the right healthcare.
exercises.zh: 只要接受合適的醫療治療，這個病通常會很快改善。
exercises.upgrade: medical treatment · 醫療治療；醫治

options.explanation: public health = 公共衛生。不是個別疾病療法。
insurance = 保險。不是直接改善病情的東西。
welfare = 福利。太廣。
medical treatment = 醫療治療。condition improves with treatment 是最自然搭配。
social support = 社會支援。可能有幫助，但不等於治療。
health policy = 健康政策。無法直接令病情快速改善。

words.note: 在醫療語境中，care 本身常可自然替代 healthcare，尤其在 access to care, quality of care, receive care 等固定搭配中。上下文必須清楚是健康／醫療。
words.example: Many patients still struggle to access care.
words.exampleZh: 很多病人仍然難以獲得照護。

exercises.original: The report focuses on unequal access to healthcare across different regions.
exercises.zh: 報告聚焦不同地區取得醫療照護機會不均的問題。
exercises.upgrade: care · 照護；醫療照顧

options.explanation: care = 照護。access to care 是極常見醫療搭配。
insurance = 保險。access to insurance 和 access to actual treatment 不完全相同。
welfare = 福利。太廣。
policy = 政策。不是病人直接取得的服務。
education = 教育。無關。
housing = 住房。無關。

exercises.original: The survey asked patients how satisfied they were with the healthcare they had received.
exercises.zh: 調查詢問病人對自己接受的照護有多滿意。
exercises.upgrade: care · 照護；醫療照顧

options.explanation: insurance = 保險。病人評價的是所接受的照護。
policy = 政策。不是 individual patient experience。
housing = 住房。無關。
welfare = 福利。不是臨床經驗。
care = 照護。the care they received 是非常自然固定搭配。
education = 教育。無關。

exercises.original: The hospital is trying to improve the quality of healthcare without increasing costs.
exercises.zh: 醫院正嘗試在不增加成本的情況下提高照護質素。
exercises.upgrade: care · 照護；醫療照顧

options.explanation: insurance = 保險。不是醫院照護質素本身。
care = 照護。quality of care 是醫療領域極常見搭配。
welfare = 福利。太廣。
policy = 政策。不是此句服務品質。
billing = 收費。和 quality of care 不同。
housing = 住房。無關。

words.note: 當 healthcare 指醫院、診所或醫療系統提供的診症、檢驗、治療、專科等一組臨床服務時，可用 clinical services。它比 health services 更專注直接臨床工作。
words.example: The hospital is expanding its clinical services in oncology and neurology.
words.exampleZh: 醫院正擴展腫瘤科和神經科的臨床服務。

exercises.original: The new centre will bring several types of healthcare together, including diagnostics, physiotherapy, and specialist consultations.
exercises.zh: 新中心會把多種臨床服務集中起來，包括診斷、物理治療和專科會診。
exercises.upgrade: clinical services · 臨床服務

options.explanation: insurance = 保險。不是中心內的服務項目。
welfare = 福利。太廣。
policy = 政策。不是可提供的臨床項目。
clinical services = 臨床服務。diagnostics + physiotherapy + specialist consultations 是典型。
social care = 社會照護。部分可配合，但 diagnostics and specialist consultations 明顯屬臨床。
housing support = 住房支援。無關。

exercises.original: The hospital reduced waiting times by reorganising healthcare across its outpatient departments.
exercises.zh: 醫院透過重組門診部的臨床服務來縮短輪候時間。
exercises.upgrade: clinical services · 臨床服務

options.explanation: housing = 住房。無關。
insurance = 保險。不是部門內服務重組。
public policy = 公共政策。不是院內門診流程。
welfare = 福利。太廣。
social support = 社會支援。不是整個門診臨床服務。
clinical services = 臨床服務。outpatient departments + waiting times 是直接醫療運作線索。

exercises.original: The review examined whether healthcare was coordinated properly between surgery, imaging, and rehabilitation.
exercises.zh: 檢討研究手術、影像和復康之間的臨床服務是否協調得當。
exercises.upgrade: clinical services · 臨床服務

options.explanation: insurance = 保險。不是 surgery/imaging/rehabilitation 的協調。
social care = 社會照護。rehabilitation 可能部分重疊，但 surgery and imaging 明確是臨床。
clinical services = 臨床服務。三個部門協調是標準 healthcare delivery 語境。
welfare = 福利。太廣。
policy = 政策。不是部門服務本身。
housing support = 住房支援。無關。

falseSynonyms.zh: 醫療保險不等於一般的 healthcare health insurance 是支付或分擔醫療費用的制度，不是實際的 healthcare 本身。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Insurance pays for care; it is not the care itself.

falseSynonyms.zh: 公共衛生不等於一般的 healthcare public health 著重整個人口的預防、監測、政策和健康促進；healthcare 更常指個人接受的醫療服務。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Public health focuses on populations; healthcare often focuses on individual care.

falseSynonyms.zh: 社會照護不等於一般的 healthcare social care 主要支援日常生活、長期照顧、殘障或長者需要，和 healthcare 有重疊但不是同一概念。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Social care supports daily living; healthcare focuses on health and medical needs.

falseSynonyms.zh: 福利不等於一般的 healthcare welfare 涵蓋收入支援、住房、社會保障等廣泛制度，範圍遠比 healthcare 大。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Welfare is broader than healthcare.

falseSynonyms.zh: 醫學；藥物不等於一般的 healthcare medicine 可以指醫學這門學科或藥物；healthcare 指服務、照護或整個醫療領域。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Medicine is a field or treatment substance; healthcare is a system or service domain.

falseSynonyms.zh: 醫院不等於一般的 healthcare hospital 是提供 healthcare 的場所之一，不是 healthcare 本身。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A hospital provides healthcare; it is not a synonym for healthcare.

falseSynonyms.zh: 治療；療法不等於一般的 healthcare therapy 是某一類治療方法，只是 healthcare 的一部分，不能涵蓋診斷、預防、手術等所有服務。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Therapy is one part of healthcare.

falseSynonyms.zh: 健康政策不等於一般的 healthcare health policy 是關於醫療與健康制度的規則和決策，不是患者實際接受的服務。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Policy governs healthcare; it is not the care itself.
